name: katanakit-wp
description: KatanaWP — code-first WordPress configuration. Bun scripts that wrap PHP via Docker (no local PHP required).
author: senseikatana - Sergio Jurado

scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run test
scripts.release: bun run check && bun run bump:patch && npm publish --access public && git push && git push --tags && node scripts/generate-release-notes.mjs "wp/v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" | gh release create "wp/v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" --notes-file -
scripts.release:minor: bun run check && bun run bump:minor && npm publish --access public && git push && git push --tags && node scripts/generate-release-notes.mjs "wp/v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" | gh release create "wp/v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" --notes-file -
scripts.release:major: bun run check && bun run bump:major && npm publish --access public && git push && git push --tags && node scripts/generate-release-notes.mjs "wp/v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" | gh release create "wp/v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")" --notes-file -
